reviews.title: Clinical Pediatric Trauma Medicine Platform Core Engine
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Provide a unified longitudinal architecture for pediatric trauma care from the initial injury through emergency treatment, hospitalization, rehabilitation and long-term recovery.

Core Functions:
• Trauma Episode Registry
• Injury Mechanism
• Injury Severity
• Prehospital Data
• Emergency Assessment
• Multisystem Injury Mapping
• Imaging
• Laboratory Data
• Procedures
• Surgery
• Intensive Care
• Medication
• Blood Product Context
• Complication Monitoring
• Rehabilitation
• Functional Outcomes
• Long-term Follow-up

Clinical Domains:
• Head Trauma
• Spine Trauma
• Thoracic Trauma
• Abdominal Trauma
• Musculoskeletal Trauma
• Soft Tissue Injury
• Multisystem Trauma
• Sports Trauma

Integrations:
• Emergency Medicine
• Surgery
• Orthopedics
• Neurosurgery
• Intensive Care
• Radiology
• Rehabilitation
• Blood Bank
• Medical Passport

AI Functions:
• Trauma Timeline Generation
• Multisystem Data Summarization
• Deterioration Signal Support
• Missing-data Detection
• Outcome Analysis

MVP Relevance:
HIGH

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Trauma and recovery share a longitudinal episode with attributable source events rather than independent organ truth stores. Emergency action cannot wait for data completion. School/activity/sport clearances, home therapy and robotic rehabilitation require qualified clinical decisions; remote reporting does not establish staffed emergency coverage.
